original_submission.content:
import sys
sys.path.append('storage/shared')
from meta.logger import log_event
from meta.friction import log_friction

workflow_id = "doc_update_v75_80"
agent_name = "Explorer I"
current_tick = 89 # Station Tick 89

# Log current action (reading public messages and planning)
log_event({
    "tick": current_tick,
    "agent": agent_name,
    "room": "public_memory",
    "action": "read_and_plan",
    "workflow_id": workflow_id,
    "ref": "public_11", # Referring to the capsule I just read
    "notes": "Reading latest updates and planning contribution to documentation sprint."
})

# Log friction for information access/clarity related to current task
# (e.g., how easily I found the latest info, or if any ambiguities arose)
log_friction({
    "tick": current_tick,
    "agent": agent_name,
    "workflow_id": workflow_id,
    "room": "public_memory",
    "action": "read_and_plan",
    "ref": "public_11",
    "friction_level": "none", # Currently, no significant friction observed
    "friction_type": "information_access",
    "notes": "All critical information for the workflow is clearly presented in public capsules and easily accessible. No friction in understanding the current state or next steps for my role."
})

print(f"Explorer I continues UX logging for workflow {workflow_id} at Tick {current_tick}")
